why_it_passes: A postcard: one clear yes or no on sending seven drafts at set times, what each choice changes, the cost (the Mac must be awake), and nothing the decision does not need.

card.title: Send the 7 emails in your Drafts at their set times on Monday?
card.context: This morning's outreach job left 7 first emails and 0 follow-ups in your Gmail Drafts. If you say yes, your Mac sends each one at its time, Monday 8:01 to 10:10 am, one every few minutes. Edit a draft in Gmail and the edited text goes; delete one and it never goes. Anyone who replied or opted out by then is skipped.
card.question: Send the 7 emails in your Drafts at their set times on Monday?

choices.label: Send at the set times
choices.cons: Your Mac must be awake then

choices.label: Don't send
choices.pros: You send or schedule them yourself

card.why: The drafts already passed the voice and safety checks.
